title: Continuation doctrine
summary: When continuing Source Editor work: inspect current repo/package first; use Source Editor itself for supported source mutations; record any bootstrap escape when the editor cannot load itself; rerun r13196 validation and regression tests; keep platform-library authority boundaries explicit; update this sphere whenever the executable/source baseline or missing-work state changes.
next: Wire oorexx_atomic_file before broadening publication semantics.
Use existing CLI UI completion/provider machinery rather than inventing a parallel renderer-specific completion system.
Treat real Codex/NewShell command transcripts as usability profiling: repeated shell choreography should become bounded object operations only when the authority belongs here.
